label: The api's settings that are not secret
code:
data:
  NODE_ENV: production
  PORT: "3000"
  DATABASE_HOST: db.internal.ricerocket.vn
  DATABASE_USER: rocket
  DATABASE_NAME: rocket
  JWT_SECRET_FILE: /run/secrets/jwt_secret

label: Every ConfigMap key as an environment variable
DATABASE_PASSWORD from the out-of-band Secret
code:
- name: DATABASE_PASSWORD
  valueFrom:
    secretKeyRef:
      name: api-secrets
      key: db-password

label: Mount the JWT secret read-only under /run/secrets
code:
volumeMounts:
  - name: jwt
    mountPath: /run/secrets
    readOnly: true

label: A volume holding only the JWT secret, as jwt_secret
code:
volumes:
  - name: jwt
    secret:
      secretName: api-secrets
      items:
        - key: jwt-secret
          path: jwt_secret
